name: api-tester
description: HTTP, GraphQL, WebSocket and SSE API testing: every body type, auth helpers (bearer, basic, API key, digest, OAuth2 with token cache), cookie sessions, project environments with {{variables}} and secrets, assertions incl. JSON Schema/OpenAPI validation, multi-step scenarios with value extraction, collection import (Postman, Insomnia v4/v5, Bruno, .http/.rest, HAR, OpenAPI) and export (Postman, .http), test generation from OpenAPI 2/3.x (Vitest, Jest, pytest, .http, scenarios), contract validation, OpenAPI mock servers with request validation, and short bounded load tests

envVars.name: API_TESTER_ALLOW_PRIVATE
envVars.description: Set to 1/true to allow requests to private networks (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7, fe80::/10). Loopback is always allowed; cloud metadata (169.254/16) is always blocked

envVars.name: API_TESTER_PROJECT_DIR
envVars.description: Project root for .api-tester/ environments, uploadable files and written outputs (default: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, then the working directory)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
envVars.description: Set by Claude Code; used as the project root when API_TESTER_PROJECT_DIR is not set

envVars.name: API_TESTER_PROXY
envVars.description: Default http:// proxy URL for outgoing requests (per-request `proxy` overrides it); may embed credentials
